label: Children with Disabilities
definition: Share of civilian noninstitutionalized children under 18 with a hearing, vision, cognitive, ambulatory, self-care, or independent living difficulty.
source: U.S. Census Bureau ACS 5-Year Estimates (Table DP02)

label: Young Children (Under Age 5 Share of Kids)
definition: Children under age 5 as a share of all children under 18.
source: U.S. Census Bureau ACS 5-Year Estimates (Table S0101)

label: Children (5-17) in Limited English Speaking Households
definition: Share of children ages 5 to 17 living in households where no one age 14 or older speaks only English or speaks English "very well."
source: U.S. Census Bureau ACS 5-Year Estimates (Tables B16003, B16004)

label: Foreign-Born Children
definition: Share of children under 18 who were not U.S. citizens at birth (born outside the U.S. to non-citizen parents).
source: U.S. Census Bureau ACS 5-Year Estimates (Tables B05003, S0101)

label: Children in Single-Parent Households
definition: Share of own children under 18 in families who live with a single parent (male or female householder, no spouse present).
source: U.S. Census Bureau ACS 5-Year Estimates (Table B09002)

label: Children in Poverty (<100% FPL)
definition: Share of children under 18 (for whom poverty status is determined) living in families with incomes below 100% of the federal poverty level.
source: U.S. Census Bureau ACS 5-Year Estimates (Table S1701)

label: Households with Children Receiving SNAP
definition: Share of households with children under 18 that received SNAP (food stamp) benefits in the past 12 months.
source: U.S. Census Bureau ACS 5-Year Estimates (Table B22002)

label: Uninsured Children (Under 19)
definition: Share of civilian noninstitutionalized children under 19 with no health insurance coverage.
source: U.S. Census Bureau ACS 5-Year Estimates (Table S2701)

label: Children Without Home Internet Access
definition: Share of children under 18 in households that have a computer but no internet subscription.
source: U.S. Census Bureau ACS 5-Year Estimates (Table B28005)
